annotations.title: Compare a job's pay with the market

description: Compares the pay stated in one job ad with what the same role pays at the same level and in the same region: the median and usual range of monthly pay, where this ad sits, and the figures by level, sector and recent quarter. The market figures match the JobCrawls salary pages: Statistics Finland earnings for the occupation raised to today where the role has one, with job ads only setting the differences; stated pay in ads otherwise. Fits "is this salary good" about a listing from search_jobs. Takes the listing id. When the ad states no pay the usual range is still returned. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.
